name: Perry Vermeer
source: Perry is Ian's flatmate. He's been a loyal friend of his since high school, and they even played in a band together during that time. When Ian had to move out of his parents' house, Perry offered him to share his family's flat for a small rent, and he accepted. Perry is laid back, lazy, and prefers to drink beer, play video games and watch porn rather than get a job or do something productive. He has artistic talents to tap into, but he needs to get off his butt and take responsibility for his life.
